summary: Zhibao Technology Inc., a Cayman Islands-incorporated foreign private issuer listed on Nasdaq, filed Form 6-K to disclose its election to rely on home-country practice exemptions under Nasdaq Marketplace Rule 5615(a)(3)(A). The company exempts itself from eight specific Nasdaq corporate governance requirements, including independent board majority, annual shareholder meeting, proxy solicitation, and shareholder approval for certain issuances. A legal opinion from Ogier (Cayman) LLP certifies that Cayman law does not prohibit these deviations. This is a routine compliance disclosure, not a special situation. No deal terms or transaction event is present; the filing merely documents ongoing governance structure.
